Doctoral programme
Doctoral programme
The VDS CoBeNe, Vienna Doctoral School in Cognition, Behavior, and Neuroscience - an interdisciplinary doctoral school uniting researchers from Biology to Psychology and the Humanities - offers flexible, research-driven doctoral programmes over three or four years. Here you can find an overview of the doctoral programmes, as well as more detailed information about the doctoral process, what to expect, and what official steps are required - from enrollment to thesis submission, defense, and degree conferral.

Information about the doctoral journey
Supervision for your PhD
Supervision is at the heart of any PhD journey.
On these pages, you can learn more about what to look out for when looking for a supervisor, as well as CoBeNe's different research areas and the supervisors active there.
Step by step guide to your PhD journey
Here you can find an overview of
The different possible routes towards a PhD
The process and timeline of a typical PhD: what to expect and what will be expected of you as a PhD candidate in the entry phase, research phase as well as in finishing your PhD, as well as CoBeNe's specific offers throughout the process
Quick links: Milestones
These pages contain information about relevant offical milestones you will be meeting during your PhD:
FÖP - Public presentation at the faculty
Doctoral thesis agreement
Thesis Advisory Committee (TAC) meetings
Annual progress reports and External credits
Dissertation and defense
Please note that for many funding schemes (e.g. dissertation completion fellowship), studying according to the university regulations is required. This includes completing these steps, such as regular TAC meetings and the submission of annual progress reports.

Information for new university members
As a new PhD candidate at the University of Vienna, you can find information concerning your entry to Austria and arrival in Vienna in the University of Vienna's Welcome Compass. These pages provide useful information about living and studying here, as well as links to institutions that can support you in getting established in Austria.
Who will help me and when?
StudiesServiceCenter
The StudiesServiceCenter (SSC) is your point of contact for many administrative processes regarding your PhD.
PhD candidates in Psychological sciences and Cognitive humanities: SSC Psychology | ssc.psychologie(at)univie.ac.at
PhD candidates in Behavioural and cognitive biology and Neurosciences: SSC Life Sciences | doktorat.lewi(at)univie.ac.at
